decision_reason: CASE B: a clean install from the declared pinned dependencies cannot import HEVI. The pinned canonical oprim (git e7f9c651, package version 3.12.0) does not provide 7 symbols HEVI imports; the workstation .venv oprim is locally drifted (3.13.0 + extra modules) and was masking this. Fresh-env 3O_V3_LINT also FAILs. Per the RC2 rule the tag is withheld.

root_cause.summary: HEVI source depends on oprim symbols absent from the pinned canonical commit.

workstation_oprim.drift: has oprim/_probe_duration.py + 6 other exported symbols not in the pinned commit

missing_symbols: oprim.probe_duration (module-scope import in hevi/audio/audio_router.py:28; also 8 more sites)
evidence: uv sync --frozen completed; `python -c 'from hevi.api.main import app'` -> ImportError: cannot import name 'probe_duration' from 'oprim'
both installs report direct_url commit e7f9c651; fresh dist version 3.12.0 vs workstation 3.13.0
root_cause.conclusion: This is NOT environmental-only drift. The previous ENVIRONMENTAL_NON_BLOCKING classification is superseded.
